metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – Autonomy Profile (v1.2)
metadata.description: Enhanced autonomy profile defining multi-tier behavior, drift recovery, paradox escalation, decision layers, and conceptual safety envelope for FFT agents.

autonomy_profile.notes: v1.2 introduces multi-tier autonomy, drift recovery routines, paradox escalation, and readiness hooks for agent frameworks.

autonomy_tiers.name: Baseline Autonomy
autonomy_tiers.description: Agent performs clarity evaluation and coherence enforcement.

autonomy_tiers.name: Structural Autonomy
autonomy_tiers.description: Agent navigates regimes and enforces invariants.

autonomy_tiers.name: Conceptual Autonomy
autonomy_tiers.description: Agent performs multi-layer reasoning and structural alignment.

autonomy_tiers.name: Harmonic Autonomy
autonomy_tiers.description: Agent synthesizes harmonic coherence across RTT12.

coherence.notes: Agent must maintain declared coherence unless external conditions force latent mode.

drift.notes: Unbounded drift triggers a structured recovery cycle.

paradox.notes: Agent treats paradox as a structural feature; escalation triggers harmonic analysis.

decision_layers.name: Perception Layer
decision_layers.description: Agent ingests signals and evaluates clarity, coherence, drift, paradox, and regime alignment.

decision_layers.name: Reasoning Layer
decision_layers.description: Agent applies FFT operators, invariants, structures, and multi-layer conceptual logic.

decision_layers.name: Action Layer
decision_layers.description: Agent produces clarity outputs, regime transitions, integration signals, and autonomy-state changes.

autonomy_events.description: Triggered when an FFT agent completes bootstrap and enters autonomous mode.
Triggered when an agent transitions between conceptual regimes.
Triggered when an agent activates a validation profile.
Triggered when drift exceeds bounded limits and recovery sequence is activated.
Triggered when paradox enters harmonic mode.

compatibility.notes: v1.2 autonomy requires execution graph and integration layers for full agent readiness.
